---
title: "Stress perception: F0 x F1 cue weighting"
---

## Workspace setup

#### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

#### Data

The combined, de-identified trial data ships as `data/spp_data.csv`. The chunk
below shows how it was built from the raw Testable exports (not included in the
repo because they carry browser and timestamp metadata).

```{r}
#| eval: false
files_to_read = list.files(
  path = "./results/",
  pattern = "*.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
data_lst <- lapply(files_to_read, function(x) {
  read_csv(x, skip = 3) %>%
    mutate(
      rownum = row_number(),
      percept = case_when(
        rownum <= 81 & response == "left"  ~ "iambic",
        rownum <= 81 & response == "right" ~ "trochaic",
        rownum >  81 & response == "left"  ~ "same",
        rownum >  81 & response == "right" ~ "different",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Catch-all for any missed cases
      )
    )
})

names(data_lst) <- seq_along(files_to_read)

spp_data <- bind_rows(data_lst, .id = "participant_num")

write.csv(spp_data, "data/spp_data.csv")
```

```{r}
spp_data <- read_csv("data/spp_data.csv")
```

## Preliminary Visualization

```{r}

id_plot_data <- spp_data %>%
  filter(rownum <= 81) %>%
  mutate(
    f0 = as.numeric(f0), 
    f1 = as.numeric(f1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(f1) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_iambic = mean(percept == "iambic", na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_trochaic = mean(percept == "trochaic", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Create the ggplot
ggplot(id_plot_data, aes(x = f1, y = prop_iambic)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "gray") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Identification Task: Cue Weighting of F1 (Vowel Quality)",
    x = "F1 Step (Vowel Centralization)",
    y = "% Iambic Responses (ob-JECT)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
id_heatmap_data <- spp_data %>%
  filter(rownum <= 81) %>%
  mutate(
    f0 = as.numeric(f0),
    f1 = as.numeric(f1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(f0, f1) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_iambic = mean(percept == "iambic", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Create the Heatmap
ggplot(id_heatmap_data, aes(x = f1, y = f0, fill = prop_iambic)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",      # Low % iambic (Trochaic/Noun)
    mid = "white",     # The 50% Perceptual Boundary
    high = "red",      # High % iambic (Iambic/Verb)
    midpoint = 0.5,
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  labs(
    title = "9x9 Identification Heatmap",
    subtitle = "White zone represents the Perceptual Category Boundary",
    x = "F1 Step (Vowel Quality)",
    y = "F0 Step (Pitch)",
    fill = "% Iambic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Prep the data
clean_data <- spp_data %>%
  filter(rownum <= 81) %>%
  mutate(
    f0 = as.numeric(f0),
    f1 = as.numeric(f1),
    is_iambic = ifelse(percept == "iambic", 1, 0)
  )

# Plot 1: The F0 (Pitch) Trend
f0_plot <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(f0) %>%
  summarise(prop = mean(is_iambic, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = f0, y = prop)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_line(color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Main Effect of Pitch (F0)", x = "F0 Step", y = "% Iambic (ob-JECT)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: The F1 (Vowel) Trend
f1_plot <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(f1) %>%
  summarise(prop = mean(is_iambic, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = f1, y = prop)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkred") +
  geom_line(color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Main Effect of Vowel (F1)", x = "F1 Step", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()

# Show them together (Requires patchwork package)
f0_plot + f1_plot
```

```{r}
clean_data <- spp_data %>%

f0_summary
```

## Discrimination

Getting only discrim trials and setting up 1s and 0s for different vs same

```{r}
discrim_data <- spp_data %>%
  filter(trialText == "LEFT = SAME SOUND; RIGHT = DIFFERENT SOUND") %>%
  mutate(diff_resp = ifelse(percept == "different", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(diff_true = ifelse(stim1 == stim2, 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    cue_type = case_when(
      grepl(",", f0) ~ "F0",
      grepl(",", f1) ~ "F1",
      TRUE ~ "Same"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(order_invariant_pair = case_when(
    cue_type == "F0" ~ sapply(strsplit(as.character(f0), ",\\s*"), 
                              function(x) paste(sort(as.numeric(x)), collapse="-")),
    cue_type == "F1" ~ sapply(strsplit(as.character(f1), ",\\s*"), 
                              function(x) paste(sort(as.numeric(x)), collapse="-")),
    cue_type == "Same" ~ paste0(f0, "-", f0)
  ))
```

Viz

```{r}
plot_data <- discrim_data %>% filter(cue_type != "Same")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = order_invariant_pair, y = diff_resp, color = cue_type, group = cue_type)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) + labs(x = "F0 and F1 Steps", y = "Proportion of 'Different' Responses", color = "Cue Type") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("F0" = "darkblue", "F1" = "darkred"),
    labels = c("F0" = "Pitch (F0)", "F1" = "Vowel (F1)") 
  ) +
theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
ggplot(filter(discrim_data, cue_type != "Same"),
       aes(x = order_invariant_pair, y = diff_resp, color = cue_type)) +
  
  # stat_summary calculates the mean of your 0s and 1s
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = cue_type), size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  
  # Aesthetics to match the 'minimal' and rotated look
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F0" = "#08306b", "F1" = "#800026")) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Discrimination Results",
    x = "Order-Invariant Step Pair",
    y = "Prop. of Correct 'Different' Responses",
    color = "Cue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
discrim_summary <- discrim_data %>%
  filter(diff_true == 1) %>% # Only look at trials where a change actually happened
  group_by(cue_type, order_invariant_pair) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_diff = mean(diff_resp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(cue_type, order_invariant_pair)

# View the results
print(discrim_summary)
```

## Pilot Study

```{r}
pilot_data <- read.csv("data/pilot_trials.csv") %>%
  filter(type == "test") %>%
  mutate(
    is_ax = grepl(",", f1) | stim2 != "",
    is_iambic = ifelse(response == "left", 1, 0),
    pressed_different = ifelse(response == "right", 1, 0)
  )

pilot_id <- pilot_data %>% filter(is_ax == FALSE) %>% mutate(f1_step = as.numeric(f1))
pilot_ax <- pilot_data %>% filter(is_ax == TRUE & grepl(",", f1)) # Only 'Different' trials


pilot_id_plot <- pilot_id %>%
  group_by(f1_step) %>%
  summarise(prop = mean(is_iambic, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = f1_step, y = prop)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkred") +
  geom_line(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Pilot Identification (F1 in Isolation)", 
       x = "F1 Step", 
       y = "% Iambic (ob-JECT)") +
  theme_minimal()


pilot_ax_plot <- pilot_ax %>%
  mutate(f1 = gsub("\\s*,\\s*", "-", f1)) %>%
  group_by(f1) %>%
  summarise(prop_diff = mean(pressed_different, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = f1, y = prop_diff, group = 1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkred") +
  geom_line(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Pilot Discrimination (F1 in Isolation)", 
       x = "Step Pair (2 steps)", 
       y = "Proportion of 'Different' Responses") +
  theme_minimal()


pilot_rt_plot <- pilot_id %>%
  group_by(f1_step) %>%
  summarise(mean_rt = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = f1_step, y = mean_rt)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkorange") +
  geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  labs(title = "Reaction Time", 
       x = "F1 Step", 
       y = "Reaction Time (ms)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display
pilot_id_plot
pilot_ax_plot
pilot_rt_plot
```
